outcome: admission to Newborn Intensive Care Unit (NICU)
cohort: The study included 522 women with singleton term pregnancies who underwent emergency caesarean sections at Alex Ekwueme Federal University Teaching Hospital, Abakaliki (AEFUTHA) between January 1, 2012, and January 1, 2016.
finding: There was no correlation between a DDI of 75 minutes or above and poor perinatal outcomes (1st and 5th minute APGAR scores, fetal outcome, or admission to NICU).
